summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democrats to win control of the Senate rose sharply today. The projected seat count moved to 55-45, up from 54-46, which would mean Democrats gain control, and [[Mississippi]] is a newly predicted flip. The market also saw a sharp rise in the chances of the Democrat Annie Andrews in [[South Carolina]], another predicted flip, and of the Democrat Scott Colom in Mississippi.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds for [[Texas]] moved sharply toward the Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the market lists the race as a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford also gained ground in a sharp move, and that race is likewise listed as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher saw a sharp rise in chances, while in Vermont the Republican Phil Scott also climbed sharply.
summaries.house: Democrats' chances of taking control of the House rose by a sizable amount in the Polymarket odds. The Democrats Lakesha Womack in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]] and J. D. Ford in [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]] each saw a sharp rise in their chances, and the market counts both as predicted flips.
